values.note: Water spigots at the front of the campground; porta-toilets and pit toilets; flush toilets, sinks and showers 'usually available' at the bathhouse in the dorm area behind the packing shed; Wi-Fi up front (password at the bulletin board, Market or Main Lodge). The $40 dump station rests on the owner's reply to a Google review; the campground page does not mention it.

values.note: 'No Need to Reserve - always plenty of space'; free-form camping with no assigned places. Pay at the honor box (cash), at the Main Lodge or Market (cards), or online (FareHarbor), which still reserves no space. Arrivals any hour.

summary: Confirmed no hookups, first-come with no reservations, 7-day limit, water spigots, pit/porta toilets, bathhouse showers, Wi-Fi up front; per-person fees ($12 15+, $6 ages 6-14) match the recorded $24. Cleared the derived year_round (it came from note text the 2026-10-01 correction removed; the page's 'Always open' is about arrivals). Not stated: season, site/rig limits beyond 'RV - any size', the dump station.
flags: Website looks tampered with: the campground page carries an out-of-place gambling link ('you can check out The Pokies for an entertaining online experience') in the middle of the resort-activities paragraph. Likely an injected or paid spam link; the rest of the page is the operator's own current content.
